tooltip.howtofish.bait: Reusable bait (15 catches). Expensive fish bites with it!
tooltip.howtofish.bait_key: Press B with the rod in hand to insert a bait.
message.howtofish.landed: The %s is on the shore! Kill it with the knife or release it (empty hand).
message.howtofish.radar_on: Radar ON - follow the bar at the top of the screen.
message.howtofish.radar_locked: The radar is silent. Bring a boss trophy to Sol first.
message.howtofish.radar_coords: Radar signal! New island: X: %s Y: %s Z: %s
message.howtofish.boss_summoned: Something enormous has taken the bait...
message.howtofish.fed_fish: Old Sol thanks you and pays %s rubles!
message.howtofish.gave_beer: Old Sol drinks the beer and hands back an empty can. Great boss bait!
message.howtofish.trophy_turned_in: Old Sol examines the shell and marks the radar: X: %s Y: %s Z: %s
message.howtofish.old_man_greeting0: §6Old Sol: §fHey! Bring me fish and I'll pay in rubles.
message.howtofish.old_man_greeting1: §6Old Sol: §fGot a beer for an old sailor? I'll make it worth your while...
message.howtofish.old_man_greeting2: §6Old Sol: §fSomething huge lurks beyond the reef. Bring me its shell and I'll set your course.
menu.howtofish.rod_bait_empty: Bait slot empty - put a bait here (or Shift+Click)
message.howtofish.beer_used: The beer bait is gone (lasts 1 catch).
message.howtofish.bait_broke: The Golden Bait wore out and crumbled!
message.howtofish.need_rod: Hold the fishing rod in your main hand and press B!
tooltip.howtofish.beer_bait: One-time bait - enough for a single catch.
atria.howtofish.hint_usage: Write your question right after the prefix: %s How do I craft a furnace?
atria.howtofish.too_long: The message is too long (max %s characters).
atria.howtofish.err_no_key: Atria Dawn is not configured: no API key. Get a key in the Atria console (atr_...) and run: /atria key atr_YOUR_KEY
atria.howtofish.err_auth: Atria Dawn rejected the API key (HTTP %s). Check the apiKey field in config/atriadawn.json.
atria.howtofish.err_limited: Atria Dawn is rate limited or busy (%s). Try again in a minute.
atria.howtofish.err_timeout: Atria Dawn did not answer in time. Try again.
atria.howtofish.err_bad_reply: Atria Dawn returned an empty or invalid answer.
atria.howtofish.busy: Atria Dawn is still typing her previous answer - wait a moment.
atria.howtofish.cmd_empty: Type a question, for example: /atria How do I craft a furnace?
atria.howtofish.cmd_reload: Atria Dawn config reloaded. API key: present.
atria.howtofish.cmd_reload_nokey: Atria Dawn config reloaded. API key: NOT set - run /atria key <key> (ops) or edit config/atriadawn.json.
atria.howtofish.about_1: %s - an AI companion living right in your chat.
atria.howtofish.about_2: How to ask: start a chat message with %s, or use /atria <message>.
atria.howtofish.about_3: /atria reset - forget the dialog, /atria key <key> - set the API key (ops), /atria reload - re-read config/atriadawn.json (ops).
atria.howtofish.about_4: Atria Dawn remembers the last %s messages of your dialogue.
atria.howtofish.cmd_key_hint: Usage: /atria key <key> - save the API key (ops), /atria key status - check it, /atria key clear - remove it.
atria.howtofish.cmd_key_set: API key %s saved to config/atriadawn.json - no reload needed. Try it: @hello, who are you?
atria.howtofish.cmd_key_invalid: This does not look like an API key (at least %s characters, no spaces). Example: /atria key atr_XXXXXXXXXXXX
atria.howtofish.cmd_key_status_cfg: API key: set (%s) - stored in config/atriadawn.json.
atria.howtofish.cmd_key_status_env: API key: taken from the environment variable %s.
atria.howtofish.cmd_key_status_none: API key: NOT set. Get a key in the Atria console, then run: /atria key <key>
